sections.heading: End-to-end security, from code to AI
sections.body:
End-to-end security, from code to AI: our own products plus specialist services. Connect offensive testing, cloud security and GRC with architecture review, security operations and incident response.

Our services bring together controls, IAM and regulation, staff education and phishing drills, and machine learning for security and risk. Linkfields IP adds AI-powered external exposure validation, code and supply-chain analysis, and a gateway for AI guardrails, cost and tracing.

sections.heading: Four specialist services, *from code to AI*
sections.body: Governance, cloud and identity, exposure validation and security operations, working with our own security products.

cards.title: AI security & GRC
cards.description: Offensive testing: AI, LLM & web app testing. Cloud security & GRC: Controls, IAM & regulation. Security awareness: Staff education & phishing drills. Accelerators: Regulatory readiness accelerator · Continuous compliance evidence.

cards.title: Cloud security & IAM
cards.description: Architecture review: Network, firewall & IAM. Connect cloud security and GRC with the controls, access decisions and regulatory requirements that shape your environment.

cards.title: Exposure validation & AppSec
cards.description: Bring external attack-surface validation together with code scanning, supply-chain analysis and offensive testing of AI, LLMs and web applications.

cards.title: Security operations
cards.description: Security operations: Splunk SIEM, Qualys monitoring. Incident response: Rapid7: detect, triage, contain. Connect security signals with investigation and a coordinated response.
